title: add CONTRIBUTING.md with basic dev setup instructions
description:
Create a minimal CONTRIBUTING.md at the repo root with:
- how to install deps (bun install)
- how to run typecheck, lint, test, build
- link to AGENTS.md for agent conventions

Keep it under 30 lines. Reference existing README.md if present.
